items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: In the Armstrong band? ... Billy Kyle, uh, uh, would vary it a bit, but not much.

ctx.x: How did, uh, the, uh, whatchamacallit, uh, the, uh, the whole band, with the piano player and the trombone player and all the rest of them do the same thing? Or would some of them get off a little more?

In the Armstrong band? Yeah. Yes, um, Edmund Hall was the only one who was, uh, doing much, uh, in the front line. Billy Kyle, uh, uh, would vary it a bit, but not much. They had their set numbers and their set way of playing them and they played them. It was, uh, they were a great crowd pleaser and, uh, drew a lot of, uh, huge audience.
